summary: Closed authentication stage 1 and its residual CLI inconsistency after PR #55 merged and main CI passed. CLI credential absence is now resolved by the shared persisted policy instead of being rejected before open-mode authorization.

Open-mode knowledge operations, online/offline identity administration, offline Hub import and logical project transfer work without token variables. Protected modes retain credential validation and scoped grants; singleton ownership is preserved.
This records source delivery and CI acceptance, not a change to the installed controller or completion of the knowledge pilot. Better Auth and scoped runtime delegation remain separate work.
